name: aranya
description: ARANYA — Ancient Wisdom. Naturally Reimagined. A premium 3D herbal wellness e-commerce platform.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @aranya/server && npm run build -w @aranya/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p e2e
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run knip && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @aranya/shared && npm run build -w @aranya/data
scripts.db:setup: npm run build:packages && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
